facts.sub: Use hurt, started, took, ate e brushed para descrever a dor. Use ago com tempo. Pergunte When did the pain start? e responda Two days ago.

facts.label: Dor de dente

facts.label: Analgésico
facts.sub: Painkillers são remédios para a dor. Diga I took a painkiller, but it didn’t help. Se a dor continuar, não adie a consulta. Peça uma consulta urgente por telefone.

pages.title: A dental office · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Friday morning in a quiet dental office in Phoenix. Soft music plays in the waiting room. Noah sits with his hand on his cheek. A nurse calls his name. He walks into a bright white room. Dr. Moon starts the visit.
“Hello, Noah. What seems to be the problem?” says Dr. Moon. “My tooth hurt a lot last night.” says Noah. “When did the pain start?” says Dr. Moon.
